messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: P2 - generation latency spike for model-x in us-west-2. Affected routes: /v1/generate (50% errors, 200ms -> 5s tail lat).
maya (oncall): Acked. investigating now. grabbing logs and core dump from the node.
maya (oncall): @trent can you help with routing fallback? sounds like KV cache pressure.
trent (eng-sre): on it. looking at autoscale events and kvcache eviction metrics. seeing a burst of long sequences ~> memory pressure.
li (eng-runtime): FYI we rolled a kernel change yesterday that changes prefetch. Could be related. checking model-x pod logs.
tr ent (eng-sre): (edited) @li can you confirm if the new kernel toggles quant path? if so we can fallback to previous variant.
li (eng-runtime): yep, quant-path flag was enabled. patching config to force non-quant fallback for model-x now: 
```
redwoodctl set-config model-x --quant=false --cache-ttl=60
```
maya (oncall): applied. restarting 2 of 4 pods in the pool to pick up config.
devops-bot: Restarting pods model-x-rc-3 and model-x-rc-4. ETA ~45s.
maya (oncall): latency improving on those pods, errors dropping to ~5%. Rolling remainder.
olivia (support): Heads up — we already saw customer A and B hit timeouts. I've opened tickets and notified PMs. Recording customer impact: ~2% of requests saw >4s latency, some timed out.
sam (product): Thanks. Can we estimate severity for postmortem and whether this needs SLA credits? @olivia
olivia (support): Tentative: customer impact is limited but covers a few paying customers with strict SLOs. Recommend severity P2 post-incident review.
trent (eng-sre): Agree P2. Root cause likely a recent kernel/quant change interacting with sequence length distribution causing cache bloat.
maya (oncall): Next steps: schedule postmortem, create action items, and tie fixes into the sprint. I'll create the postmortem doc after stabilization.
maya (oncall): Action items (quick triage):
- ACTION-1: li -> revert/guard quant-path flag for model-x + add feature flag gating. Estimate: 2d. Priority: High (Q3 security/perf tie-in).
- ACTION-2: trent -> add KV cache eviction metrics + alert threshold (alerts at 70% mem). Estimate: 1d. Priority: Medium.
- ACTION-3: maya -> customer impact notes + SLA assessment with support. Estimate: 0.5d. Priority: High.
- ACTION-4: sam -> add regression test to eval harness for long sequences for model-x. Estimate: 3d. Priority: Medium (Q3 roadmap).
- ACTION-5: devops -> create automated canary that runs new kernel flags on 5% traffic. Estimate: 2d. Priority: High.
sam (product): I'll intake ACTION-4 into the Q3 sprint board. Recommend we tag ACTION-1 as a hotfix for immediate put-on-call and then schedule follow-up refinement.
trent (eng-sre): I'll draft the PRs and link to the postmortem. Also adding a temporary routing rule to prefer older instance types if cache pressure spikes.
li (eng-runtime): starting the revert PR now. will include a boolean config and fallback. assigning to @maya for rollout verification.
maya (oncall): Verified rollback on 4 pods, full pool steady. marking incident resolved in pager. incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated by oncall. next: postmortem.
incident-bot: Please schedule a postmortem meeting within 3 business days and add attendees: oncall, eng-sre, eng-runtime, product, support. Use channel #incidents for notes.
maya (oncall): Scheduling: proposing Thu 15:00 PT in incident-review. Anyone not available?
sam (product): I can attend.
olivia (support): attending, will bring customer timelines.
trent (eng-sre): attending.
li (eng-runtime): attending.
maya (oncall): OK added. I will create the postmortem doc and populate initial timeline and action items. Moving ACTIONs into backlog and tagging owners.
maya (oncall): Post-incident scoring: impact=2 (limited customers), duration=45m, recurrence risk=2, mitigation complexity=3. Recommend severity P2 and mark for Q3 remediation sprint.
sam (product): Suggest we prioritize ACTION-1 (revert/guard) as hotfix in next patch window, and put ACTION-4 in next minor release for eval coverage.
olivia (support): I'll follow up with customers to offer details and timeline for fix. If SLA credits needed, I'll coordinate with finance.
trent (eng-sre): I'll convert ACTION-2 into an alert runbook and add a paging escalation for cache-pressure.
maya (oncall): thanks all. closing thread — will paste postmortem link here when ready.
maya (oncall): Postmortem: https://redwood.docs/postmortem/2207654321 (draft) :thumbsup:
